item.title: Project Research Scientist III (Non-Medical) - GIS Specialist
item.description: CCDC is recruiting a GIS Specialist for CHARM-India, a climate and health adaptation project. The role leads spatial data integration, climate-health vulnerability mapping, the Climate-Health Vulnerability Index (CHVI), and geospatial dashboards for hospital climate resilience planning.
item.author: Centre for Chronic Disease Control (CCDC) (New Delhi)

item.title: Research Associate / Junior Project Assistant
item.description: JSAC is recruiting Research Associates and Junior Project Assistants for remote sensing and geospatial applications. The roles support satellite data processing, GIS analysis, and project mapping.
item.author: Jharkhand Space Applications Centre (JSAC) (Ranchi)

item.title: Water Resource Engineer / Business Consultant / Disaster Management Expert / Office Coordinator (Multiple Positions)
item.description: AG Horizon is recruiting for multiple water resources, consulting, disaster management, and office coordination roles across its Guwahati and Gurugram offices. Current openings are listed on the official recruitment page.
item.author: AG Horizon Pvt. Ltd. (Guwahati / Gurugram)

item.title: Project Associate - Geospatial Modelling & Urban Heat Island Studies
item.description: NRSC Hyderabad engages project associates for geospatial modelling of urban land surface dynamics and heat island intensity across Indian cities. The associate will process satellite time series, derive land-surface and thermal indices and support urban heat studies for national programmes. The position is contractual under an ongoing project.
item.author: National Remote Sensing Centre (NRSC), ISRO (Hyderabad)

item.title: Project Associate - Geospatial Analysis for Urban Green Infrastructure
item.description: ATREE's urban research programme recruits a Project Associate to map and assess urban green infrastructure across fast-growing Indian cities. The associate analyses satellite and civic datasets to evaluate canopy cover, access equity and cooling benefits. The role bridges geospatial analysis with city engagement for practical planning inputs.
item.author: ATREE (Bengaluru)

item.title: Young Professional-II (Remote Sensing & GIS)
item.description: ICAR-NBSS&LUP, Nagpur is engaging one Young Professional-II (RS & GIS) on a purely contractual basis. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:00 AM.
item.author: ICAR - National Bureau of Soil Survey and Land Use Planning (NBSS&LUP) (Nagpur)

item.title: GIS Trainer (Trainee) - Remote
item.description: GIS Trainer (Trainee) at GeoInfra Technologies India. 100% remote (work from home). Monthly salary Rs 45,000 fixed. Conduct live online GIS training sessions.
item.author: GeoInfra Technologies India (Remote (India))
